WITHDRAW ChatGPT_F001 — prior schema feedback accepted. The prior finding was a near-duplicate of Gemini_F001/C0009 and lacked measured post-fix σ evidence, so I withdraw it rather than resubmit it unchanged.

CONFIRM C0021 — The `section_terminator` search omits `re.IGNORECASE`, unlike `marker_match`, so a lower/mixed-case next section such as `Novelty:` is not recognised and the ADMISSIBILITY block can consume downstream text. Concrete trace: with `ADMISSIBILITY:\n  S_min: PASS\nNovelty:\n...`, `marker_match` succeeds, but `section_terminator` does not match `Novelty:` because it is compiled with only `re.MULTILINE`. The block therefore extends past the real boundary. This is a confirmed parser-boundary bug.

EXTEND C0011 | The same hyphen-variant flaw also affects the ASCII `sigma-measured` spelling of `σ_measured`. Current code has `gate_patterns.append(r"sigma[_\s]*measured")`, which accepts `sigma_measured` and `sigma measured` but rejects `sigma-measured`, despite the parser claiming separator tolerance. This is the same root-cause family as C0011, not a new discovery.

No new DISCOVERY findings filed this round. I found no novel CRITICAL/HIGH issue not already represented by the active or settled registry.
